contracts.name: DotnsProtocolRegistry
contracts.description: dotNS protocol-level address registry used by contracts to resolve sibling protocol components at runtime.

contracts.name: Multicall3
contracts.description: Generic Multicall3 helper for batching dotNS and other Asset Hub contract reads.

contracts.name: DotnsRegistrar
contracts.description: ERC721 token of record for .dot names, with controller-gated minting and PopRules-priced, fee-gated transfers.

contracts.name: DotnsRegistry
contracts.description: Forward dotNS registry for node ownership, resolver selection, and subname records.

contracts.name: DotnsRegistrarController
contracts.description: Commit-reveal public registration controller for dotNS names.

contracts.name: DotnsPopController
contracts.description: Gateway-only controller issuing lite- and full-person PoP usernames, with per-label base-name reservation queues.

contracts.name: RootGatewayDispatcher
contracts.description: Root-authority dispatcher that forwards verified gateway calls into the PoP controller.

contracts.name: PopRules
contracts.description: Proof-of-Personhood policy and pricing rules for dotNS registration and transfer flows.

contracts.name: DotnsResolver
contracts.description: Forward resolver mapping each dotNS node to a single address record, writable by the node owner.

contracts.name: DotnsReverseResolver
contracts.description: Reverse resolver that maps owner accounts back to dotNS names.

contracts.name: DotnsContentResolver
contracts.description: Contenthash and text-record resolver for dotNS nodes, with operator-delegated record management.

contracts.name: DotnsPopResolver
contracts.description: Resolver for PoP-issued records: per-node chat keys and bidirectional lite/full username links.

contracts.name: DotnsNameEscrow
contracts.description: Escrow contract for dotNS release positions, transfer friction fees, and overpayment accounting.

contracts.name: StoreFactory
contracts.description: Factory deploying each user's permanent LabelStore and UserStore as beacon proxies behind two upgradeable beacons.

contracts.name: LabelStoreBeacon
contracts.description: Upgradeable beacon that points StoreFactory-created label stores at the current LabelStore implementation.

contracts.name: UserStoreBeacon
contracts.description: Upgradeable beacon that points StoreFactory-created user stores at the current UserStore implementation.
